audit.whatIsWrong: Every field treats Rune Prison as an unconditional root — 'W root into Q chain', 'Root you with W then chain Q-E-Q', 'respect the W root angle', 'whenever he wastes W root on a minion'. The condition is never stated.
audit.why: Rune Prison roots only if the target already has Flux on them. Without Spell Flux applied first it damages and slows, nothing more. That single conditional is the whole matchup: the ability to dodge is Spell Flux, not Rune Prison, and a Tahm Kench who sidesteps the E can walk into the W and eat a slow he was going to eat anyway. Telling the player to respect the W teaches him to fear the wrong cast and to give up free ground to the one that actually matters.
audit.corrected: Rune Prison only roots through Spell Flux. Dodge the E and his W is a slow you can walk through — the E is the ability to respect, and it is on 3.5s at rank 1 so he will throw it freely.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ryze.json (W Rune Prison, E Spell Flux)

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere says that Overload is a line projectile stopped by the first thing it hits.
audit.why: Overload damages the first enemy struck. In a top lane with a wave between you, that means standing behind your own minions makes Ryze's primary damage and his entire rune-charging engine unusable against you. For a melee tank whose only job is to survive to first item, that is the single most valuable piece of positioning advice in the matchup, and the entry instead tells the player to 'weather the poke'.
audit.corrected: Overload stops on the first enemy hit — stand behind your wave and his Q simply cannot reach you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Abyssal Dive is never mentioned, and whys[2] claims 'you cannot reliably close without burning Flash'.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive is 1000-1200 range with a knockup, available from level 2. Ryze's Spell Flux and Rune Prison are both 615 range and he has no dash anywhere in his kit — his only mobility is the brief move-speed burst on a 2-rune Overload. Tahm Kench does not need Flash to close on Ryze; he needs to not walk in on foot.
audit.corrected: Abyssal Dive covers 1000+ units from level 2, well past his 615 range, and Ryze has no dash to answer it.

audit.whatIsWrong: full breakdown.cooldowns calls Rune Prison 'His point-blank root'.
audit.why: Rune Prison is 615 range on an 11/10.5/10/9.5/9 cooldown. That is not point-blank, and it is inside Tongue Lash's 900 — the useful framing is that you outrange his lockdown setup by nearly 300 units, not that he has to touch you.
audit.corrected: Rune Prison is 615 range, 11s at rank 1, and only roots through Flux. Tongue Lash reaches 900.

audit.why: spikes[1] correctly identifies Realm Warp as a roam and macro tool rather than a lane kill button — it is a 180/160/140 delayed portal with no damage. That read is right and needs no change.

edits.before: At levels 1 and 2 this lane is genuinely even — Ryze's early Q poke is real but your Thick Skin passively banks it as grey health the moment you step out of combat. Use Tongue Lash's range to contest the wave and begin stacking An Acquired Taste, but do not hard-commit to a trade without 3 stacks because his W root into Q-E-Q chain comes online at level 3 and will burst you before you can Devour him. At level 3 he owns the initiative — respect the W root angle, hug the wall side of the lane to limit his root setup, and wait for him to waste W before you fish for your stun.
edits.after: At levels 1 and 2 this lane is genuinely even — Ryze's Q poke is real, but Overload stops on the first enemy it touches, so standing behind your own wave takes it off the table entirely. Use Tongue Lash's 900 range to contest CS from safety and begin stacking An Acquired Taste. From level 3 his kill pattern is Spell Flux into Rune Prison: the root only exists if the Flux lands first, so the ability to sidestep is the E, not the W. Dodge it and his lockdown is a slow you can walk through — and then you can fish for your stun.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 5 are a farm-and-stack phase where neither of you has a clean kill window — Ryze kites too well to let you walk him down pre-6, and you heal back most of what his Q rotation does with grey health recovery. Use Tongue Lash to chip him through the wave and keep refreshing Acquired Taste stacks so the stun is ready the moment he missteps. At level 6 his Realm Warp is a roam threat, not a lane-kill button — mirror his level 6 window by pushing the wave fast with empowered autos, taxing his CS, and threatening the Devour combo anytime he wastes W root on a minion.
edits.after: Levels 4 through 5 are a farm-and-stack phase where neither of you has a clean kill window — but Ryze has no dash anywhere in his kit, and his only mobility is the short move-speed burst on a 2-rune Overload. You heal back most of his Q rotation as grey health. Keep refreshing Acquired Taste so the stun is ready the moment he missteps, and open with Abyssal Dive rather than walking. At level 6 Realm Warp is a roam threat, not a lane-kill button — shove fast, tax his CS, and threaten Devour whenever his Spell Flux misses.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ryze Spell Flux: matchup-defining — Rune Prison only roots through Flux, so dodge the E and his W is a slow. Rune Prison is 615 range, 11s; Tongue Lash reaches 900. - Devour needs 3 stacks: kill windows only.

edits.before: Ryze wins by landing Rune Prison, denying your pattern, and kiting you off the wave.
edits.after: Ryze wins by landing Spell Flux into a Rune Prison root and poking you off the wave.

notes: This entry never mentioned Abyssal Dive once in any field, which is why it kept concluding Tahm Kench 'cannot close without Flash' against a champion with no dash. That pattern is likely to repeat wherever the generator wrote the W as the old 'Abyssal Voyage' escape rather than a gap-closer — worth checking across the champion, not just this matchup.
